comment.text: WHR1 D89 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Source observations include Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cutaneous melanoma; Skin tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.

An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting WHR1 residue D89 have been observed in cutaneous melanoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
